title: Notice regarding non availability of Hon'ble Mr. Justice Utkarsh Thakorbhai Desai on 09.10.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 09/10/2026
It is hereby notified that on 09.10.2026;

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 09/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-03/2026
It is hereby notified that on 09.10.2026;
(1) Hon’ble Mr. Justice Utkarsh Thakorbhai Desai would
not be available.
(2) Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice N. S.
Sanjay Gowda and Hon’ble Mr. Justice J. L. Odedra)
would take up the matters notified in the Cause list of
Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K.
Vishen and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Utkarsh Thakorbhai
Desai.)
(3) Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K. Vishen would sit
Single and take up the matters at Sr. No. 174 to Sr.
No. 200 notified before Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble
Mr. Justice Aniruddha P. Mayee.)
By Order of Hon’ble Acting The Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
